contract.note: The family owns the shared Canvas Node shell, presentation states, read-only Prompt body markup, multi-selection overlay and Prompt-family focus surface; Smart Canvas owns coordinates, editable Prompt behavior, selection identity and bounds, mutations and run behavior.

components.purpose: Render the shared visual shell for one persisted Smart Canvas Node while the caller supplies domain-specific body content and behavior.

ownership.family: shared shell, kind and state presentation, read-only Prompt body markup, resize and quick-add control markup, multi-selection overlay presentation and contract validation
ownership.smartCanvas: Node data, Canvas coordinates, editable domain body markup, selection bounds and gestures, production event binding, Canvas Mutation, Connection, floating toolbar positioning and Generation Run
ownership.reviewFixture: Local Node and model data only; the component library runs the production Smart Canvas renderer and interaction modules in a transient session

accessibility.label: Every instance requires a non-empty aria-label describing the Node role or visible title.
accessibility.content: Interactive body content remains in Light DOM so existing focus, editing and Canvas hit-testing behavior stays observable to the caller.
accessibility.invalidContract: Invalid kind, state, id or label is exposed through data-ic-contract-status and data-ic-contract-reason.

components.purpose: Render the shared visual overlay and resize handles around an explicit multi-Node Canvas Selection while Smart Canvas supplies bounds and gestures.

ownership.family: 2px focus Border, four inverse-scale corner handles, resize-hit identification and contract validation
ownership.smartCanvas: Selected Node identities, projected bounds, visibility, move/resize gestures and mutations

accessibility.label: Every instance requires a non-empty label used by the resize handle.
accessibility.visibility: The caller keeps aria-hidden synchronized with the open state.

components.purpose: Present one shared modal editing surface for Prompt Node and Prompt Generation Node content without adding a visible collapse control.

ownership.family: Backdrop, centered modal geometry, dialog semantics, outside-area dismissal, Escape dismissal and contract validation
ownership.smartCanvas: Prompt-family eligibility, Node body markup, edit persistence, Mention Picker precedence, open state and focus restoration

accessibility.label: Every instance requires a non-empty label forwarded to the internal dialog surface.
accessibility.keyboard: Escape requests dismissal unless a child overlay has already consumed the key event.
accessibility.pointer: Clicking the backdrop requests dismissal; clicks within slotted Node content do not.

liveMatrix.layout: one production Node kind per row; at least two stable data-driven cases per row; the Image Node row also covers production image, empty, video and audio media states; the Generation Node row covers reference image and video generation; production Text Annotation Nodes provide the row labels
